title: Billing and Coding: Sacroiliac Joint Nerve Blocks

codes.1: Note: Providers are reminded to refer to the long descriptors of the CPT codes in their CPT book.
codes.2: For ASC facility and OPPS hospital outpatient department claims only. Note: Providers are reminded to refer to the long descriptors of the HCPCS codes in their HCPCS book.
codes.3: Consistent with the LCD, the following CPT/HCPCS codes do not support medical necessity and are non-covered when billed on the same claim, same DOS, as 27096, 64451, or G0260: 01991 and 01992. Note: Providers are reminded to refer to the long descriptors of the CPT/HCPCS codes in their CPT/HCPCS book.

covered.1: It is the provider’s responsibility to select codes carried out to the highest level of specificity and selected from the ICD-10-CM code book appropriate to the year in which the service is rendered for the claim(s) submitted. The following ICD-10-CM code(s) support medical necessity and provide coverage for CPT/HCPCS code(s): 27096, 64451, and G0260 .

noncovered.1: All those not listed under the “ICD-10-CM Codes that Support Medical Necessity” section of this article.
